open_points.subject: canonical_bytes
open_points.text: MUST first, before json_text is parsed, raise NonCanonicalValueError with a reason naming the depth when json_depth of the UTF-8 bytes of json_text exceeds the imported RELEASE_CEILING_JSON_DEPTH_MAX constant, so no parse recurses deeper than that constant
open_points.other_text: or when a string holds a lone surrogate.
open_points.question: Which requirement must change: computing json_depth from UTF-8 bytes before parsing, or accepting a Python str containing a lone surrogate far enough to raise NonCanonicalValueError? A lone surrogate cannot be encoded as UTF-8, so the required pre-parse conversion can instead raise UnicodeEncodeError.
